contract.semantics: Native accepted visible AST text only, including code/captions/merged source partitions once; words and graphemes cross formatting runs within each text domain, never invented block separators. Metadata, hidden tables, comments and pending proposals are excluded.
contract.source: Native exact owner/publication checks precede reading; DOM heading selection additionally requires the retained immutable read from this very host and existing guarded selection queue. Stale/foreign/forged/composing sources reject; no refresh-and-retarget retry.
contract.controls: Borrowed bounded/paginated literal outline and six metrics; all native entries remain available. Publication immediately invalidates actionable rows. Read-only navigation, ordinary edits/history, remote refresh, closed hosts and reentrant refusal retain original owner semantics.
contract.persistence: No save family/operation/command/view union widened. Exact earlier readers restore 30 utility-created checkpoints and match 120 future boundaries; older utilities are explicitly unavailable. Managed reopen/source/React StrictMode retain history and exclusive writer leases.
contract.candidatePipeline: Both profiles require current paired-runtime and managed startup probes plus the fresh installed consumer. Portable stages need no local historical cache; pinned earlier proof is separate and explicitly requested.
